sanskrit: adhva̍ryo̱ adri̍bhiḥ su̱taṁ soma̍m pa̱vitra̱ ā sṛ̍ja | pu̱nī̱hīndrā̍ya̱ pāta̍ve ||
english: O Adhvaryu, release into the filter the Soma pressed with the stones; purify it for Indra to drink.

sanskrit: di̱vaḥ pī̱yūṣa̍m utta̱maṁ soma̱m indrā̍ya va̱jriṇe̍ | su̱notā̱ madhu̍mattamam ||
english: Press out the supreme elixir of heaven, this most honey-sweet Soma, for Indra the wielder of the vajra.

sanskrit: tava̱ tya i̍ndo̱ andha̍so de̱vā madho̱r vy a̍śnate | pava̍mānasya ma̱ruta̍ḥ ||
english: O Indu, the gods partake of that sweet drink of yours, of the sweet juice of you who flow in purification — the Maruts do so.

sanskrit: tvaṁ hi so̍ma va̱rdhaya̍n su̱to madā̍ya̱ bhūrṇa̍ye | vṛṣa̍n sto̱tāra̍m ū̱taye̍ ||
english: For you, O Soma, when pressed, invigorating, pour yourself for the exhilaration of the vehement one; O bull, be the aid of the singer of praise.

sanskrit: a̱bhy a̍rṣa vicakṣaṇa pa̱vitra̱ṁ dhāra̍yā su̱taḥ | a̱bhi vāja̍m u̱ta śrava̍ḥ ||
english: Flow onward, O all-discerning one, pressed, with a stream through the filter; flow onward toward strength and toward glory.

sanskrit: pari̍ dyu̱kṣaḥ sa̱nadra̍yi̱r bhara̱d vāja̍ṁ no̱ andha̍sā | su̱vā̱no a̍rṣa pa̱vitra̱ ā ||
english: May the heaven-dwelling bestower of wealth, through his inebriating liquor, bring us strength; pressed out, flow into the filter.

sanskrit: tava̍ pra̱tnebhi̱r adhva̍bhi̱r avyo̱ vāre̱ pari̍ pri̱yaḥ | sa̱hasra̍dhāro yā̱t tanā̍ ||
english: By the ancient paths of yours, beloved, through the sheep's-wool filter, may he of a thousand streams pass along in full body.

sanskrit: ca̱rur na yas tam ī̍ṅkha̱yendo̱ na dāna̍m īṅkhaya | va̱dhair va̍dhasnav īṅkhaya ||
english: O Indu, like a cauldron rock it — rock that generous gift; rock it with your weapons, O bearer of weapons.

sanskrit: ni śuṣma̍m indav eṣā̱m puru̍hūta̱ janā̍nām | yo a̱smām̐ ā̱dide̍śati ||
english: Press down, O Indu, the vigor of these peoples, O much-invoked one — of him who attacks us.

sanskrit: śa̱taṁ na̍ inda ū̱tibhi̍ḥ sa̱hasra̍ṁ vā̱ śucī̍nām | pava̍sva maṁha̱yadra̍yiḥ ||
english: O Indu, flow in purification for us with a hundred aids — or a thousand — of the bright ones, O lavish bestower of riches.

sanskrit: ut te̱ śuṣmā̍so asthū̱ rakṣo̍ bhi̱ndanto̍ adrivaḥ | nu̱dasva̱ yāḥ pa̍ri̱spṛdha̍ḥ ||
english: Your powers have risen up, O stone-crusher, shattering the Rākṣasas; drive away those who are rivals.

sanskrit: a̱yā ni̍ja̱ghnir oja̍sā rathasa̱ṁge dhane̍ hi̱te | stavā̱ abi̍bhyuṣā hṛ̱dā ||
english: This one has struck down with might at the chariot-encounter when the prize is at stake, to be praised with a fearless heart.

sanskrit: asya̍ vra̱tāni̱ nādhṛṣe̱ pava̍mānasya dū̱ḍhyā̍ | ru̱ja yas tvā̍ pṛta̱nyati̍ ||
english: The sacred ordinances of this flowing Soma are not to be defied, not easily broken; break the one who contends against you.

sanskrit: taṁ hi̍nvanti mada̱cyuta̱ṁ hari̍ṁ na̱dīṣu̍ vā̱jina̍m | indu̱m indrā̍ya matsa̱ram ||
english: They urge him on — the tawny one that sheds exhilaration, the prize-winning Indu flowing through the rivers — for Indra, the enrapturing one.

sanskrit: a̱sya pra̱tnām anu̱ dyuta̍ṁ śu̱kraṁ du̍duhre̱ ahra̍yaḥ | paya̍ḥ sahasra̱sām ṛṣi̍m ||
english: Following the ancient brightness of this one, the unfailing ones have milked out his bright milk — the seer who wins a thousand.

sanskrit: a̱yaṁ sūrya̍ ivopa̱dṛg a̱yaṁ sarā̍ṁsi dhāvati | sa̱pta pra̱vata̱ ā diva̍m ||
english: This one, like the sun, is visible all around; this one runs through the lakes, along the seven downward slopes to heaven.

sanskrit: a̱yaṁ viśvā̍ni tiṣṭhati punā̱no bhuva̍no̱pari̍ | somo̍ de̱vo na sūrya̍ḥ ||
english: This one, while flowing in purification, stands over all beings — Soma, the god, like the sun.

sanskrit: pari̍ ṇo de̱vavī̍taye̱ vājā̍m̐ arṣasi̱ goma̍taḥ | pu̱nā̱na i̍ndav indra̱yuḥ ||
english: O Indu, flowing in purification, you course around us with cattle-rich prizes for the delight of the gods, O you who are eager for Indra.

sanskrit: yava̍ṁ-yavaṁ no̱ andha̍sā pu̱ṣṭam-pu̍ṣṭa̱m pari̍ srava | soma̱ viśvā̍ ca̱ saubha̍gā ||
english: O Soma, pour around us with your inebriating liquor — more and more nourishment, more and more abundance — and all good fortunes.

sanskrit: indo̱ yathā̱ tava̱ stavo̱ yathā̍ te jā̱tam andha̍saḥ | ni ba̱rhiṣi̍ pri̱ye sa̍daḥ ||
english: O Indu, according as your praise song rises, according as your inebriating juice has flowed forth — take your seat on the dear sacred grass.

sanskrit: u̱ta no̍ go̱vid a̍śva̱vit pava̍sva so̱māndha̍sā | ma̱kṣūta̍mebhi̱r aha̍bhiḥ ||
english: O Soma, flow in purification with your inebriating liquor, knowing where the cattle are and knowing where the horses are, with the swiftest days.

sanskrit: yo ji̱nāti̱ na jīya̍te̱ hanti̱ śatru̍m a̱bhītya̍ | sa pa̍vasva sahasrajit ||
english: He who conquers and is not conquered, who slays the enemy fearlessly — flow in purification as the winner of thousands.

sanskrit: pari̱ soma̍ ṛ̱tam bṛ̱had ā̱śuḥ pa̱vitre̍ arṣati | vi̱ghnan rakṣā̍ṁsi deva̱yuḥ ||
english: Soma, swift and eager for the gods, flows around the great Ṛta in the filter, smashing the Rākṣasas.

sanskrit: yat somo̱ vāja̱m arṣa̍ti śa̱taṁ dhārā̍ apa̱syuva̍ḥ | indra̍sya sa̱khyam ā̍vi̱śan ||
english: When Soma flows for the prize, his hundred streams are active, entering into friendship with Indra.

sanskrit: a̱bhi tvā̱ yoṣa̍ṇo̱ daśa̍ jā̱raṁ na ka̱nyā̍nūṣata | mṛ̱jyase̍ soma sā̱taye̍ ||
english: The ten maidens have cried out to you as to a lover, as young women do; you are polished, O Soma, for winning the prize.

sanskrit: tvam indrā̍ya̱ viṣṇa̍ve svā̱dur i̍ndo̱ pari̍ srava | nṝn sto̱tṝn pā̱hy aṁha̍saḥ ||
english: O sweet Indu, flow around for Indra and for Viṣṇu; protect the men, the singers of praise, from distress.

sanskrit: pra te̱ dhārā̍ asa̱ścato̍ di̱vo na ya̍nti vṛ̱ṣṭaya̍ḥ | acchā̱ vāja̍ṁ saha̱sriṇa̍m ||
english: Your unceasing streams flow onward like the rains from heaven, toward the thousand-fold prize.

sanskrit: a̱bhi pri̱yāṇi̱ kāvyā̱ viśvā̱ cakṣā̍ṇo arṣati | hari̍s tuñjā̱na āyu̍dhā ||
english: Viewing all the beloved poetic powers, the tawny one flows on, thrusting forward his weapons.

sanskrit: sa ma̍rmṛjā̱na ā̱yubhi̱r ibho̱ rāje̍va suvra̱taḥ ||
english: He, being polished by the living beings, like a mighty king of good vows, settles like a falcon at the resting-place.

sanskrit: sa no̱ viśvā̍ di̱vo vasū̱to pṛ̍thi̱vyā adhi̍ | pu̱nā̱na i̍nda̱v ā bha̍ra ||
english: O Indu, flowing in purification, bring us all treasures from heaven and from upon the earth.

sanskrit: tara̱t sa ma̱ndī dhā̍vati̱ dhārā̍ su̱tasyāndha̍saḥ | tara̱t sa ma̱ndī dhā̍vati ||
english: Swiftly he runs, that exhilarating one — the stream of the pressed inebriating juice; swiftly he runs, that exhilarating one.

sanskrit: u̱srā ve̍da̱ vasū̍nā̱m marta̍sya de̱vy ava̍saḥ | tara̱t sa ma̱ndī dhā̍vati ||
english: He knows the morning cattle of treasures, the divine aid for mortal man; swiftly he runs, that exhilarating one.

sanskrit: dhva̱srayo̍ḥ puru̱ṣantyo̱r ā sa̱hasrā̍ṇi dadmahe | tara̱t sa ma̱ndī dhā̍vati ||
english: From the two dusty, far-reaching ones we receive thousands; swiftly he runs, that exhilarating one.

sanskrit: ā yayo̍s tri̱ṁśata̱ṁ tanā̍ sa̱hasrā̍ṇi ca̱ dadma̍he | tara̱t sa ma̱ndī dhā̍vati ||
english: From those two we receive by lineage thirty and also thousands; swiftly he runs, that exhilarating one.

sanskrit: pava̍sva go̱jid a̍śva̱jid vi̍śva̱jit so̍ma raṇya̱jit | pra̱jāva̱d ratna̱m ā bha̍ra ||
english: Flow in purification, O Soma — winner of cattle, winner of horses, winner of all, winner in battle; bring a jewel together with offspring.

sanskrit: pava̍svā̱dbhyo adā̍bhya̱ḥ pava̱svauṣa̍dhībhyaḥ | pava̍sva dhi̱ṣaṇā̍bhyaḥ ||
english: Flow in purification among the waters, O inviolable one; flow in purification among the plants; flow in purification among the divine intelligences.

sanskrit: tvaṁ so̍ma̱ pava̍māno̱ viśvā̍ni duri̱tā ta̍ra | ka̱viḥ sī̍da̱ ni ba̱rhiṣi̍ ||
english: You, O Soma Pavamāna, cross over all difficulties; O seer, take your seat upon the sacred grass.

sanskrit: pava̍māna̱ sva̍r vido̱ jāya̍māno 'bhavo ma̱hān | indo̱ viśvā̍m̐ a̱bhīd a̍si ||
english: O Pavamāna, knower of the sun-realm, as you were born you became great; O Indu, you have prevailed over all.

sanskrit: pra gā̍ya̱treṇa̍ gāyata̱ pava̍māna̱ṁ vica̍rṣaṇim | indu̍ṁ sa̱hasra̍cakṣasam ||
english: Sing forth in the Gāyatrī meter — Pavamāna the all-surveying, Indu of a thousand eyes.

sanskrit: taṁ tvā̍ sa̱hasra̍cakṣasa̱m atho̍ sa̱hasra̍bharṇasam | ati̱ vāra̍m apāviṣuḥ ||
english: You, the thousand-eyed one, and moreover the one bearing a thousandfold — they have purified you through the filter.

sanskrit: ati̱ vārā̱n pava̍māno asiṣyadat ka̱laśā̍m̐ a̱bhi dhā̍vati | indra̍sya̱ hārdy ā̍vi̱śan ||
english: Flowing in purification, having dripped through the filters, he runs toward the jars, entering into the heart of Indra.

sanskrit: indra̍sya soma̱ rādha̍se̱ śam pa̍vasva vicarṣaṇe | pra̱jāva̱d reta̱ ā bha̍ra ||
english: O Soma, O all-surveying one, flow in purification auspiciously for Indra's bounty; bring seed together with offspring.
